definitions.explanation: Something happening or coming to mind without planning or intention.
Something occurring incidentally without deliberate action.

examples.english: I suddenly looked out the window.

examples.japanese: ふと⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}した→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: A memory from the past suddenly came to me.
Before I knew it, it was already night.

examples.japanese: ふと⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見上|みあ}げた→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧。
examples.english: I suddenly looked up at the sky.

examples.japanese: ふと⟦{疑問|ぎもん}→疑問：02648_gimon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
ふと⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
ふと⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|さ}ました→覚ます：02057_samasu⟧。

examples.english: When I happened to look, there was a cat.

examples.japanese: ふと⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{寄|よ}った→立ち寄る：04638_tachiyoru⟧。
examples.english: I happened to stop by the bookstore.

examples.japanese: ふと⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It was someone I met by chance.

notes:
ふと describes sudden, unintentional actions or realizations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ふと⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧/ふと⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (suddenly looking; as I happened to look)
- ふと⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to suddenly think)
- ふと⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧ (to suddenly remember)
- ふと⟦{気|き}がつく→気がつく：21794_kigatsuku⟧ (to suddenly notice/realize)

USAGE:
- Implies the action was not planned or deliberate
- Often used for moments of reflection or realization
- Suggests a brief, fleeting quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧: suddenly (more dramatic, external events)
- ⟦{急|きゅう}に→急に：00263_kyuuni⟧: suddenly (more abrupt)
- ⟦たまたま→偶々：03408_tamatama⟧: by chance (for coincidences)

ふと is gentler and more introspective than ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧, often describing internal experiences like thoughts or glances.
